# Benchmark limits of the regression guard (scripts/bench-gate.sh; SDD-004 section 12, SDD-009 section 13).
# <profile> <Benchmark> <unit> <min|max> <limit>
# Each limit is the slowest value measured on ubuntu-latest (nightly run 133226885991, CI run
# 133561986165, 2026-11-16) worsened by the 20% of SDD-008 section 7, and never looser than the NFR
# it belongs to. Set it again from a fresh run on the same runner after an intended change.
#
# pr: the fast ones, run by the Go tests job (ubuntu-latest, export-1 shard). nightly: all of them.

# The compositor (SDD-004 section 12). 1.696 / 3.248 / 3.019 / 0.919 times real time.
pr      BenchmarkComposeRotated      x_realtime min 1.36
pr      BenchmarkComposeColorMatrix  x_realtime min 2.60
pr      BenchmarkComposeFilter       x_realtime min 2.42
pr      BenchmarkComposeBlur         x_realtime min 0.74
nightly BenchmarkComposeBlur8Bands   x_realtime min 0.73
nightly BenchmarkSampleRotatedFullFrame8Bands ns/op max 25100000
nightly BenchmarkCopyFullFrame       ns/op max 1700000

# The caption rasterizer: 17 us hit. The miss was 7.35 ms on the Go rasterizer and measured 9.17 ms on the Rust
# one under wazero (CI, 2026-11-21); the limit of 11 ms is that value worsened by the 20% of SDD-008 section 7.
pr      BenchmarkCaptionMiss         ns/op max 11000000
pr      BenchmarkCaptionHit          ns/op max 20600

# NFR-001, commit round trip p95: 13.7 ms and 16.5 ms (limit 50 ms). Commit200Items does real moves since
# f988fd94d and measured 23.9 ms (CI, 2026-11-21); its limit is the 25 ms of SDD-005 section 18 check 12.
pr      BenchmarkCommit200Items      p95-ms max 25
nightly BenchmarkRoundTrip200Items   p95-ms max 19.8

# NFR-006 and NFR-007 (60 s export, 500 MB), NFR-009 project: 1.407 times real time, 122 MB.
nightly BenchmarkExportCommonCase    x_realtime min 1.14
nightly BenchmarkExport60s           s_export max 50.1
nightly BenchmarkExport60s           peak_MB max 127
nightly BenchmarkExportScale60s      s_export max 51.2
nightly BenchmarkExportScale60s      peak_rss_MB max 147
nightly BenchmarkReleaseFPS60        x_realtime min 10.2
nightly BenchmarkReleaseFourK        x_realtime min 0.095
nightly BenchmarkReleaseFourK        peak_MB max 461
nightly BenchmarkReleaseGIF          x_realtime min 21.5
nightly BenchmarkReleaseAnimatedImage x_realtime min 4.98

# NFR-004, NFR-022, NFR-023 and NFR-005 (limits 500 ms, 1,600 tokens, 2 s, 30 s).
nightly BenchmarkViewFrameColdScale/UI540    p95_ms max 95
nightly BenchmarkViewFrameColdScale/Agent384 p95_ms max 90
nightly BenchmarkViewSheet9Scale     tokens max 1600
nightly BenchmarkViewSheet9Scale     sheet_ms max 700
nightly BenchmarkIngest60s           s_ingest max 24.6
